title: North Korea Moves $247 Million of Binance Hack Loot Through Bitcoin Mixers
summary: Roughly a month after the $6.4 billion hack, Elliptic says nearly all of the coinjoin mixing was coordinated by one person who “refuses to block funds such as these."

title: Solo Bitcoin Miner Scores Again, Hitting $191,000 Jackpot Against the Odds
summary: The lone miner solved block 977057 through Solo CKPool, pocketing 3.13 BTC (worth about $191,000) in a lottery-like feat that normally only industrial-scale mining farms pull off.

title: Tom Lee Says Ethereum Is as Scarce as Bitcoin—And Bitmine Just Bought More
summary: Chairman Tom Lee argued ETH’s supply has grown just 0.90% annually since mid-2025—roughly matching Bitcoin’s 0.82% and far below Solana, XRP and Cardano.

title: Bitcoin Rallies, Anthropic Sinks as Nvidia Surges 35% on Jensen Huang’s Return
summary: Nvidia’s comeback sent chip shares soaring and gave Bitcoin a lift after a punishing selloff. Anthropic, fresh from its record IPO, missed the party.

title: Morning Minute: Crypto Rebounds after NVDA Drives Friday Selloff
summary: The Nasdaq dropped 10% last week. Bitcoin lost 10% in a single day on Friday amidst cascading selloffs, though a relief rally is underway.

title: Strategy Buys $30M in Bitcoin, Moves $1B From USD Reserve to Cash Pot
summary: Michael Saylor's firm raised its preferred stock buyback program to $4 billion after repurchasing another $212 million of STRC last week.

title: Czech Authorities Charge 15 Over $12M Unlicensed Crypto Casino
summary: Investigators say "decentralized" casino BETFIN was run centrally, inflated its player numbers with bots and made $12 million illegally.

title: Bitcoin Rebounds to $61K After Weekend Plunge to Two-Year Low
summary: Bitcoin swung by more than $6,000 over the weekend as tech stocks slid and spot ETFs logged their biggest daily outflow since June.

title: GTA 6 Leaker Dangles a PC Port Behind a $15 Million Crypto Pump
summary: The anonymous leaker, Cyberleek, released a 209 GB Xbox build but is withholding the executable that could enable a PC port until its CYBERLEEK token hits $15 million.

title: Fraudsters Used Fake Crypto Exchanges to Steal $37 Million, SEC Alleges
summary: The agency says eight Colorado-registered entities, likely run from overseas, posed as legitimate advisers and crypto platforms—even faking SEC certificates and filings—to defraud U.S. investors of more than $37 million.

title: Is the AI Bubble Finally Popping? Nvidia Crashes 48% as Wall Street Experts Sound the Alarm
summary: Tech stocks are buckling after Anthropic’s historic IPO and Nvidia’s leadership crisis, while Bitcoin has slipped below $60,000. Experts disagree on whether AI faces a correction or a dot-com-style bust.

title: Nvidia Shares Sink to 52-Week Low After Report SEC Is Probing Accounting
summary: Nvidia shares fell about 13% to a 52-week low after reports that SEC enforcement staff are examining potential accounting issues, adding to pressure on the chipmaker after Jensen Huang’s resignation.

title: Cathie Wood Bets $91M on Anthropic IPO While Paring Crypto Exposure
summary: The firm bought 934,968 Anthropic shares across six ETFs on the Claude maker’s Nasdaq debut while trimming a combined $4.1 million from its Ethereum and Solana staking ETFs.

title: Wrapped Monero Token Collapses 99% After $13 Million Hack Blamed on Web Host
summary: Wagyu’s XMR1 token fell more than 99% after an attacker moved 5.2 million tokens out of its deployer account and sold a fraction of them for $13.5 million.

title: Bitcoin Breaks Below $60K as Crypto Fear Index Hits Worst Level Since February
summary: Bitcoin broke below $60,000 Friday as crypto sentiment collapsed and AI-linked stocks sank after Anthropic’s IPO.
